metadata.name: fee_router
metadata.description: ICEmarkets fee router: DBC fee_claimer / DAMM v2 position owner; splits COIN fees to holders, buyback, protocol

instructions.name: claim_damm
docs: CPI `cp_amm::claim_position_fee`; quote split, base → treasury[base_mint] (MVP).

instructions.name: claim_dbc
docs: CPI `dynamic_bonding_curve::claim_trading_fee(0, u64::MAX)` then split.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Keeper, admin, or anyone once `PERMISSIONLESS_CLAIM_INTERVAL` has elapsed.

accounts.name: treasury_base
docs: DBC `token_a_account` (base). max_base_amount = 0, so normally unchanged.

accounts.name: router_quote_recv
docs: DBC `token_b_account` (quote). Router's receiving ATA.

instructions.name: claim_dbc_surplus
docs: CPI `dynamic_bonding_curve::partner_withdraw_surplus` then split. Keeper only.

instructions.name: record_migration
docs: Keeper/admin: store damm_pool + position after `migrate_damm_v2`.

accounts.name: position_nft_account
docs: Token-2022 account holding the position NFT; must be owned by the router PDA.

instructions.name: register_pool
docs: Permissionless: validates `dbc_config.fee_claimer == router PDA` (raw bytes, see constants::dbc_layout).

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: COIN

accounts.name: treasury_base
docs: Receives any base-token fees (DBC `token_a_account`, DAMM v2 base side). MVP: stays in treasury.

accounts.name: router_quote_recv
docs: Router's temporary receiving ATA for COIN (shared per coin; claims split the delta only).

instructions.name: register_pool_admin
docs: Admin override of `register_pool` (skips layout checks).

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: COIN

accounts.name: treasury_base
docs: Receives any base-token fees (DBC `token_a_account`, DAMM v2 base side). MVP: stays in treasury.

accounts.name: router_quote_recv
docs: Router's temporary receiving ATA for COIN (shared per coin; claims split the delta only).

instructions.name: withdraw_for_buyback
docs: CPI-only from the buyback program (signer = buyback PDA["bb_auth"]).

accounts.name: bb_authority
docs: Buyback program's PDA["bb_auth"].

instructions.name: withdraw_for_epoch
docs: CPI-only from the distributor (signer = distributor PDA["dist_auth"]).

accounts.name: dist_authority
docs: Distributor program's PDA["dist_auth"] (signs via invoke_signed inside the distributor).

errors.name: InvalidDbcAccount
errors.msg: Account is not a valid DBC account

errors.name: FeeClaimerMismatch
errors.msg: DBC config fee_claimer is not the router PDA

errors.name: ConfigMismatch
errors.msg: DBC pool does not belong to the given config

errors.name: MigrationNotRecorded
errors.msg: Pool migration not recorded in router

errors.name: InvalidDammAccount
errors.msg: Account is not a valid DAMM v2 account

errors.name: InvalidPositionNft
errors.msg: Position NFT account invalid or not owned by router

errors.name: ClaimTooSoon
errors.msg: Claim too soon for a non-keeper caller

errors.name: InvalidAuthority
errors.msg: Caller is not the authorised program signer

types.name: FeesClaimed
docs: source: 0 = DBC trading fee, 1 = DBC surplus, 2 = DAMM v2 position fee

types.name: PoolState
docs: PDA["pool", dbc_pool].

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: COIN

types.name: RouterConfig
docs: PDA["router"]. Also the signing authority: DBC `fee_claimer`, DAMM v2 position-NFT owner,
and token authority of buyback_vault[coin], treasury[mint] and the router's receiving ATAs.

fields.name: peg_desk_program
docs: Carved out of the contract's `_reserved[64]` (layout of all fields above is unchanged):
owner program of `Commodity` accounts, checked by permissionless `register_pool`.

types.name: VaultWithdrawn
docs: kind: 0 = epoch (distributor), 1 = buyback, 2 = treasury (admin)
